scientific_rules.FRFCFS: Queue-size changes memory-partition credit coupling; not isolated L2 capacity
scientific_rules.GM_populations: Per-metric paired; per-profile common quad; fixed ALL profiles common intersection separately
scientific_rules.L2_counters: Last-printed L2 buckets are per-stream cumulative. Whole-declared-trace L2 counters shown only with complete single-stream header evidence; otherwise null with raw per-stream values retained. DRAM counters are global cumulative.
scientific_rules.P0_denominator: Same design, same input, accepted P0 only
scientific_rules.frozen_architecture: No DTC architecture, L2 capacity or clock changes
scientific_rules.latency: Last printed average is not a weighted whole-application statistic
scientific_rules.uniform_configuration: Each GM uses one fixed profile; no per-program best selection

snapshot_note: Inputs are coherent individual file snapshots, not a transaction spanning controller and all results. New completions can occur during collection.
